candidates.title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models
candidates.reason: Foundational large-model training systems work that eliminates optimizer/gradient/parameter-state memory redundancy through partitioning.

candidates.title: Memory-efficient Transformers via Top-k Attention
candidates.reason: Memory-efficient attention mechanism that restricts attention to top-k keys and serves as a useful precursor for sparse long-context inference systems.

candidates.title: 8-bit Optimizers via Block-wise Quantization
candidates.reason: Training-memory optimization that reduces optimizer-state footprint through block-wise quantization and is directly relevant to large language model training.

candidates.title: Self-attention Does Not Need O(n²) Memory
candidates.reason: Foundational exact-attention algorithm reducing memory complexity from quadratic to linear without approximation, directly relevant to memory-efficient Transformer execution.

candidates.title: The case for 4-bit precision: k-bit Inference Scaling Laws
candidates.reason: Systematic low-bit inference scaling study that quantifies model-size/precision trade-offs and provides a foundational design point for quantized LLM inference.
